authority_scope: Post-Stage15 prospective M1-M4 common initial siting amendment

all_required: PCC transformer and three-phase connection exist in Generated_ThreePhase_PCC_v3.dss
host bus is present and energized in the exact frozen IEEE-123 model
base snapshot Fresh Exact OpenDSS converges without command errors

snapshot_selection.timezone_semantics: AEMO fixed AEST interval-end timestamps converted to UTC interval starts

rooftop_pv_repair.allowed_sequence: exact deduplication; same-timestamp satellite fallback; linear interpolation only when measurement and satellite are both absent for an explicitly authorized defect

snapshot_selection.duplicate_resolution: for each rule inspect candidates in deterministic criterion order and take the earliest UTC timestamp not already selected
rules_in_order: maximum rooftop PV among intervals at or below the annual median net load
maximum operational net load among intervals at or below the annual 20th percentile rooftop PV
multivariate median condition by normalized L1 distance over net load, gross load, PV, and 30-minute ramp

staged_selection_no_weighted_sum.stage_2: retain candidates at or above the feasible-candidate median source-path |Z|
staged_selection_no_weighted_sum.stage_3: lexicographically rank by smaller minimum voltage margin, then larger voltage-deviation p95, then larger local/downstream loading-risk p95, then service_id; retain the first eight
staged_selection_no_weighted_sum.stage_4: require positive standardized grid-support response: +DeltaP or +DeltaQ improves candidate-region voltage-deviation L1 by more than 1e-8 pu while increasing neither global voltage-deviation L1 nor global maximum thermal loading by more than 1e-8; if fewer than four pass, fail closed
staged_selection_no_weighted_sum.stage_5: evaluate every four-site combination from the remaining eligible set and choose lexicographically: largest minimum pairwise electrical-tree |Z| distance; smallest maximum common source-path impedance overlap ratio; best sorted vulnerability-rank tuple; best sorted support-rank tuple; largest sorted source-distance tuple; lexicographically smallest sorted service-id tuple

metric_definitions.candidate_region: candidate host bus plus descendants in the deterministic source-rooted shortest-|Z| tree
metric_definitions.voltage_deviation: mean absolute voltage magnitude deviation from 1.0 pu over the stated region (normalized L1)
metric_definitions.thermal_loading: maximum exact OpenDSS line or transformer loading in per unit
metric_definitions.local_downstream_loading_risk: per-snapshot maximum loading among the source-to-host path and candidate descendant subtree, aggregated as p95 across snapshots
metric_definitions.network_loss: negative sum of OpenDSS Circuit.Losses converted from watts to kW is not used; positive real Circuit.Losses/1000 is reported
metric_definitions.electrical_distance: accumulated positive-sequence series R and X on the deterministic source-rooted energized path; regulator/transformer series impedance is included on its source-side base where available

assignment_rule.selected_site_order: final selected sites sorted by the frozen final selection trace, then service_id
